name: io.github.lx1112/token-safety-check
description: Rug check tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana: 0-100 risk score + reasons

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding a little USDC on Base; pays $0.01 per check

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_SAFETY_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse checks priced above this many USD (default 0.05)
